notes.title: Galaxy Engine 1.7.0 - Optics Update
notes.content:
[p][b]This new major update brings light simulation with ray tracing, as well as some quality of life additions and bug fixes.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Changelog:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added ray-traced light simulation[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Optics" tab[/p][/*][*][p]Added new tools menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Long Exposure" feature[/p][/*][*][p]Added new presets showcasing the new optics features[/p][/*][*][p]Added new basic stats for optics (enable optics to see them)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI readability[/p][/*][*][p]Galaxy Engine now uses 16 bits-per-channel color data internally. This enables more accurate colors, especially for dark values.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I decided to go for a PBR approach, meaning that you can make scenes and modify materials similar to how you would in a traditional 3D path tracer. The lighting simulation does approximate some things more than others, like energy conservation and dispersion.[/p][p]The ray tracer is geometry-based, which means that it doesn't use mathematical functions for shapes. Instead, shapes are made out of individual edges, again, similar to 3D rendering tools. This means that walls and shapes have edge normals and vertex normals. These normals allow smooth shading while using actual geometry.[/p][p]
[/p][p]All that said, here is a list of features the ray tracer showcases:[/p][p][/p][p]Diffuse lighting[/p][p]Specular reflections[/p][p]Refraction[/p][p]Emission[/p][p]Specular roughness[/p][p]Refraction roughness[/p][p]Fresnel simulation[/p][p]Index of Refraction (IOR)[/p][p]Nested dielectrics with different IOR[/p][p]Light dispersion[/p][p]Total internal reflection[/p][p]Sampling with ray accumulation[/p][p]Wall creation[/p][p]Draw shape tool[/p][p]Lens creation tool[/p][p]Circle creation tool[/p][p]Diffuse color editing[/p][p]Specular color editing[/p][p]Refraction color editing[/p][p]Emission color editing[/p][p]Light color editing[/p][p]Shape relaxation[/p][p]Point lights[/p][p]Area lights[/p][p]Cone lights[/p][p]Light spread[/p][p][/p][p]Here you can see a video that showcases some of the new features:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="wxoEvtipIrg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]I have a background in 3D rendering, and now that I know how to code, I thought to myself: "I could make my own ray tracer!" And so, this is why I started working on this update. It was a fun experiment, and I'm glad that I did it. But now that I've finally finished it, I'm getting back to particles.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you like it![/p]

notes.title: Galaxy Engine 1.7.0 - Optics Update Beta 5
notes.content: [p]This new beta update brings some quality of life features:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Tool menu[/p][/*][*][p]Optics selection tool[/p][/*][*][p]Optics eraser[/p][/*][*][p]Now optics elements can be modified after being placed. Use the select tool to select the assets you want to modify and then just adjust the settings from the lighting tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Deleted alpha contribution for lights and walls colors[/p][/*][*][p]The scene now renders after adjusting the lighting settings automatically[/p][/*][*][p]Changed a little how the heavy particles spawning behaves. Now they are only accessible from the tools menu (all the shortcuts are untouched)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Galaxy Engine 1.7.0 - Optics Update Beta 4
notes.content: [p]Building optical instruments like telescopes, cameras and more is now possible in Galaxy Engine![/p][list][*][p]Added lenses[/p][/*][*][p]Added drawable shapes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed diffuse lighting appearing with full refraction[/p][/*][*][p]Made default global light absorption more subtle[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Show Normals" button[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Symmetrical Lens" button[/p][/*][/list][p]I plan on adding more features before releasing the full 1.7.0 update. I want to add stuff like volumetric lighting, a tool menu for more intuitive controls, sphere lights (circle actually, but sphere sounds nicer), and more. [/p][p]You can also check all of these new features' source code here: [url="https://github.com/NarcisCalin/Galaxy-Engine"]https://github.com/NarcisCalin/Galaxy-Engine[/url][/p]

notes.title: Galaxy Engine 1.7.0 - Optics Update Beta 3
notes.content: [p]Refraction is fun, this is the first step towards building telescopes in Galaxy Engine![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added refraction[/p][/*][*][p]Added new refraction color editor[/p][/*][*][p]Added new refraction roughness slider[/p][/*][*][p]Added new refraction amount slider[/p][/*][*][p]Removed specular amount slider[/p][/*][*][p]Set default samples to 1[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Galaxy Engine 1.7.0 - Optics Update Beta 1
notes.content: [p]This upcoming release will include light simulation as well as some other visual improvements.[/p][p]These are a list of features that are included in the beta 1 update:[/p][list][*][p]2D Ray tracing with global illumination[/p][/*][*][p]New "Lighting" tab[/p][/*][*][p]Modified internal rendering to use 16 bits per channel. This greatly improves color visuals with dark colors or large particles[/p][/*][*][p]Added new "Max Dynamic Size" slider[/p][/*][*][p]Added new "Min Dynamic Size" slider[/p][/*][*][p]Now fullscreen is actually windowed borderless[/p][/*][/list][p]You can find the current placeholder controls in the new "Lighting" tab[/p]

notes.title: Galaxy Engine 1.6.0 - Solids Update

This new update also brings multiple new fun and useful features for the players to explore, which include enhanced brush drawing, pin feature, mesh visualization and more![/b][/p][p]Here you can check out new video showcasing some of the new features:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="vu9Ld46LirI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Changelog:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added constraint physics[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Particle Constraints" button[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Unbreakable Constraints" button[/p][/*][*][p]Added "P" shortcut for Constraint Solids[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Constraint Solids" button in the Right-click menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Constraint Selected" button in the Right-click menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Delete All Constraints" button in the Right-click menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Del. Constraints" button in the Right-click menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Constraints Stiffness Multiplier" slider[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Constraints Resistance Multiplier" slider[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Visualize Mesh" feature[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Draw Constraints" feature[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Iron" material[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Rubber" material[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Mass Multiplier" button in the visuals tab[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Constraint Stress Color" mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Pin" particles feature[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Fluid Mode brush drawing[/p][/*][*][p]Now the simulation can run when the window is minimized[/p][/*][*][p]Material buttons are now enabled only if Fluid Mode is active[/p][/*][*][p]Internally modified the save system. notes.title: Galaxy Engine 1.6.0 Beta 1
notes.content: [h3]This new beta update includes the upcoming constraint physics system.[/h3][p][b]How to enable the beta branch:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Right-click on Galaxy Engine.[/p][/*][*][p]Go to properties.[/p][/*][*][p]Go to Betas.[/p][/*][*][p]Select the "betafeatures" branch[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]How to test out the new constraints:[/b] [/p][olist][*][p]Enable "Particle Constraints"[/p][/*][*][p]Select the particles you want to add constraints to.[/p][/*][*][p]Press "P" on your keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Now the particles are tied together[/p][/*][/olist][p]This is still in progress, so you can expect bugs here and there.[/p][p]Please, let me know if you find any bugs.[/p][p]Join our Discord community! [url="https://discord.gg/Xd5JUqNFPM"]https://discord.gg/Xd5JUqNFPM[/url][/p]

notes.title: Galaxy Engine 1.4.0 - Better Fluids Update
notes.content:
[b]This major update adds a lot of new features and improvements like better fluids, more materials, a UI redesign, expanded recording functionality, and more![/b]

[b]The new fluids use a basic variant of the PCISPH algorithm, which enforces incompressibility much better than before. This stops fluids from collapsing and makes materials behave in a more realistic manner. These new fluids are a step closer to a more realistic simulation[/b]

[i]Note:[/i] Any saved scenes prior to this version will not be compatible with the new version.

Here is a video that shows some of the most relevant new features: [previewyoutube=k6whorF35oU;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Changelog:[/i]

[list]
[*] Made major improvements to fluids by using a variation of the PCISPH algorithm for better incompressibility
[*] Added new SPH ice material
[*] Added new SPH mud material (previous mud is now named soil)
[*] Added new SPH delta slider, which controls overall incompressibility of SPH materials
[*] Added new SPH max velocity slider, to avoid particles getting flung at very high speeds
[*] Added new advanced stats tab with many new fun graphs and statistics
[*] Added new Pressure Color visuals
[*] Added max Pressure Color slider
[*] Added max Velocity Color slider
[*] Added new record functionality
[*] Added new record tab
[*] Made new presets for this version
[*] Redesigned the entire UI
[*] Renamed DeltaV Color to ShockwaveColor
[*] Improved color customization in the right-click menu. This means that now the colors are explicitly modified instead of using a basic color multiplier. This makes color customization much easier and intuitive
[*] Right-click color customization now works in SPH color mode too
[*] Reduced brush minimum size
[*] Fixed description text for some visuals buttons
[*] Made minor optimizations
[/list]
